title: The scalar counit restricted to singles
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$ and Chern data $c$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. Write $s_R,s_A$ for the degree-zero single functors on the actual $R_T$- and $A_T$-module systems, and write $E_c=c.\mathrm{scalar.model.E}$, $S_c=c.\mathrm{scalar.T}$. Define $q_c:s_RS_c\to E_cs_A$ by the universal scalar counit on single complexes, preceded by the source single/localization comparison and followed by the localized ordinary single comparison and the inverse target single/localization comparison. This composite of natural transformations is scalarSingleCounit. Its component at $c.\mathrm{rootModule}$ is definitionally lineComparison; it is defined for every $R_T$-module system without a flatness hypothesis. Compositions of functors are read from left to right.
